How we staff the work

One name on the job

Whoever takes your first call stays with your account. They already know your setup by the second visit.

Specialists when it helps

If a problem needs deeper networking or training expertise, we bring in the person who does that — at the same rate.

We grow slowly

When the work outpaces us we hire people we would trust in our own homes, not the cheapest bid available.

Technology help for people, and their businesses, organizations, and communities.
